name: How Can I Make My New Bathroom Actually Last?

step.name: Step 1
step.text: A stunning bathroom is great, but its beauty will be short-lived if it’s not built to handle moisture properly. Long-term durability comes from focusing on the technical details behind the pretty finishes.

step.name: Step 2
step.text: First and foremost: waterproofing. This is not a step to cut corners on. A properly installed waterproofing membrane behind your shower tiles and on the floor is your number one defense against leaks, which can lead to rot and mold. Second, prioritize ventilation. A high-quality, properly sized exhaust fan is non-negotiable. It pulls moist air out of the room, preventing moisture from lingering and causing damage over time. Third, choose your materials wisely. Select flooring that’s slip-resistant and durable in wet conditions, and consider grout that’s stain-resistant and easier to maintain. Finally, never let an unqualified person handle your plumbing or electrical work. It’s a safety risk and can cause you to fail inspections.
